Jules (Marketing): Quick sync 1: new battlecard angle proposal: 'Serving guarantees > model bragging' with three punchpoints: predictable unit-cost, latency SLOs, safe rollouts. Uploaded draft: https://redwood.app/drafts/serve-angle
Asha (Field): Love it. Can we add two micro-scripts for SDRs: one that surfaces "noisy neighbor" pain, another that surfaces compliance/private deployment needs.
Marco (Product): Add a short technical footnote: latency numbers vary by seq len and batching. Link to live benchmark CSV rather than hard numbers.
Bea (Growth): For launch posts: split into technical thread (bench + reproducible tests) and executive post (savings + reliability story). Two CTAs: "Try 14-day Dedicated" and "Download reproducible CSV".
Jules (Marketing): Proposed inbound routing rules pasted below. Simple and actionable.
```
if message contains (cost OR price OR savings) -> tag:cost -> growth-flow
if message contains (sla OR uptime OR compliance OR private) -> tag:enterprise -> enterprise-sdr
if message contains (benchmark OR latency OR p95 OR p99) -> tag:tech -> assign:solutions-eng
```
Asha (Field): Also flag any mention of "private" or "kms" as high-touch and add to enterprise queue.
ops-bot: Benchmark CSV uploaded: https://bench.redwood/2026-03-19/run123.csv
Marco (Product): For procurement rebuttal, try this line: "Cloud endpoints are great for fast dev. For predictable cost and SLOs, teams choose dedicated inference to avoid tail-latency and noisy neighbors."
Bea (Growth): I'll draft webinar hook: 6-min demo (region fail -> model variant fallback) + 10-min Q&A. CTA copy incoming.
Jules (Marketing): Owners: Bea -> CTAs + webinar; Asha -> SDR micro-scripts; Marco -> attach benchmark link in battlecard; I'll finalize battlecard v1 tomorrow. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
